Six years ago today, a Cleveland police officer killed #TamirRice.

Tamir should be alive today and 18 years old. We will never forget him – and we will never stop fighting for him. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/JSiiNqLStz

Atatiana Jefferson should be alive.
Rayshard Brooks should be alive.
Ahmaud Arbery should be alive.
Breonna Taylor should be alive.
Elijah McClain should be alive.
Tony McDade should be alive.
George Floyd should be alive.
Sean Reed should be alive.
#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/fiyYH3ZMYc

#GeorgeFloyd was murdered in Minneapolis 200 days ago.

We continue to #SayHisName, to fight for justice, and to demand bold, systemic change in America. We won’t stop. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/OvJoRReILn

Breonna Taylor was murdered nine months ago today.

We can't forget her. We can't stop honoring her life. We have to keep fighting for her and for the justice she deserves. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/Jd3O9z6RTE

DC police are investigating as possible hate crimes the burning and destruction of #BlackLivesMatter signs in Washington, DC this weekend at Asbury United Methodist Church and Metropolitan AME Church, where Frederick Douglass’ funeral was held in 1895. https://t.co/pvUNPohR69

George Floyd, Breonna Taylor, Ahmaud Arbery, Tony McDade, Rayshard Brooks, and far too many others were senselessly murdered this year.

We must never forget them.
We must never stop fighting for them.
We must never stop working to honor their lives. #BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/annCTd1xWn

Oscar Grant was murdered 12 years ago in Oakland, California.

He should be alive today. #BlackLivesMatter
